parameters.name: payload
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({patient_id: $json.patient_id, recipient: $json.recipient, phone: $json.phone, channels: $json.channels, message: $json.message, urgency: $json.urgency, role: $json.role}) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO escalation_logs (patient_id, escalation_tier, escalation_level, urgency, reasons, notify_roles, escalated_at, response_deadline) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) RETURNING id

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({success: true, escalation_tier: $json.escalation_tier, escalation_level: $json.escalation_level, urgency: $json.urgency, notifications_sent: $json.notifications_sent || 0, response_deadline: new Date(Date.now() + $json.response_time_hours * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()}) }}
